verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering professional legal services, not a software product or platform. Connecting an agent through an official MCP server is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence pack shows no software surface at all: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
